title: Superdry Essential Logo Embroidered Slim Fit Tee (Asphalt Grey) $9 (RRP $39.95) + $12.95 Delivery @ Superdry
body:

[myfab4] No option for click and collect :(
$12.95 postage
[Rebengaaa] Great price aside from shipping cost. However, a cautionary note - grey usually is a terrible colour for showing sweat stains. In my experience fabric type plays into it, but I usually avoid grey shirts for this reason.
[Flakuciernie63] It use to be quality brand
Pre 2020
Unfortunately not anymore
[Skinnerr] Add to that basically every brand that existed then independently, now owned by private equity.
[MILKAPIG] What actually changed?
I got a chino from there post 2020 and is good but can't compare to before, had shirts pre COVID that were good too
[DiLs] Let us know when you post second time, so we can be unkind.
[GreenRomeo] How’s the quality compared to AS Colour I wonder?
[Jimothy Wongingtons] As colour kinda fell off imo
And I say that as someone who usually buys 5-6 as colour classics basics from iconic every 6-8 months
[MMM] Thanks OP got some $9 ones just delivered from previous deal and happy to get some more!
[Aguynamedlance] Looks like they've updated it. Only the grey show as $9
[8azinga] Deal title says grey only. Did you see other colours at $9?
[Fuzor] These were a great shirt with quality materials when I bought them last year. Perhaps they've messed around with manufacturing and thickness of materials to get it down to this price
[donman92] Dang it good deal shame the texture looks super uncomfortable :(
[8azinga] Forgot TCB. they have 4% cashback but did get NRMA cashback just from using CC. NO need to go through a website first and it can double up for both.
